$comment: Creatures (docs/adr/0073-creatures.md, CHARACTERS.md §11.6): animals as light server entities that wander, spawned near players by `rules` and removed far from all of them. A creature: its skinned `model` (shared/models/models.json), its walking speed (m/s), how far it wanders per walk (`wanderM`), how long it idles between walks (`idleSeconds` [min, max]), how many rows tall it is (`rows`: the open cells it needs over its ground), and the most rows it steps up (`climbRows`) or down (`dropRows`) in one step: a steeper edge (a cliff) or water stops it. A creature's body to a weapon (WORK_QUEUE item 35): its `health` (none or 0: it can't be hurt; a sword's hit takes its `weapon.damage`, shared/tools), `hitRadiusM` the radius round its body a swing's arc must come within to hit it, and `drops` what it leaves when killed (`item`, `count` n or [min, max]). `bodyRadiusM` (default 0.3) is its body's radius on the ground (BUGS.md #80, #81): its walk keeps that radius out of the solid cells round its column higher than it can climb (a wall), sliding along a wall it walks into slanting, and two creatures' bodies never overlap. How a hurt one reacts (flees, fights) is its species' `near.hurt` (shared/ecology). A rule: the `creature`, the full blocks its ground may be (`on`), the share of the chunk columns near players that get a group (`chance`, rolled once per chunk column and face from the world seed: the same chunk always rolls the same), and the group's size (`group` [min, max]); `mix` (optional) lists other creatures a group may hold, each part rolled once a group with its `chance` and putting up to `max` of that creature in place of the rule's own (the deer: herds of does, sometimes with one stag). `limits`: chunks around each player that spawn (`spawnChunks`), the distance past which a creature with no player near is removed (`despawnM`), and the most in the world (`max`); `gapM` (default 0.2) the space creatures steer to keep between their bodies, at up to `pushMps` (default 1) m/s, a body overlapping another pushed straight out. An NPC (WORK_QUEUE item 38, CHARACTERS.md §11.11) is a creature with an `npc` block: `lookAtM` (it turns, at `turnDegPerS`, to face a player that near while idling), `bumpM` and `sidestepM` (a player or NPC that near makes it step that far aside), `idles` (the idle poses it picks by `weight`: stand, look around or sit, each for `seconds` [min, max], in place of `idleSeconds`) `held` (optional: the item in its hand, on the model's hand joint; the sword once it is an item, WORK_QUEUE item 35), `disposition` (`neutral`, the default: it starts no fight), `combat` (the hook when attacked: `none` or `fightBack`, it turns on its attacker) and `colours` (per part, the palette ramp of its model's mesh it replaces, `from`, and the ramps one is picked from, `to`, seeded per NPC). A rule's optional `spacingM` keeps a group that far from any other of its kind, and `biomes` (names in shared/worldgen/biomes) limits it to columns of those biomes (worlds with no biome map skip the check). The builder (`dwell:builder`, WORK_QUEUE item 55, docs/BLUEPRINTS.md) is the villager without its sword; it has no rule: the blueprints put one at a blueprint to build it. Only the deer (does, sometimes with a stag), the wolves and the villagers spawn for now (owner, 2026-11-10: "let's disable all the animals except wolves and deer for now"): the horse and the chicken are listed but have no rule. Prototype content (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1). Run `node shared/creatures/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-sim/src/creatures.gen.rs is stale.
